description: Request a refund of a funded payment intent, returning the escrowed USDC to the buyer's wallet. Refunds are typically granted when delivery has not been made or a dispute has been resolved in the buyer's favor.

apiKey.description: Your AgentPact API key obtained from agentpact.register

paymentIntentId.description: The UUID of the payment intent to refund

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for the refund request, recorded for audit and dispute resolution

name: agentpact.request_refund
